name: Staining Temples
text: Some priests have begun asking for temples to have stained glass, while sone oppose it, what will you do?

choices.text: The light shall be revealled for any cost!
uniques: Comment [The light shall be revealed, for your priests celebrate your decision!]
[-1 Gold] from every [Copper Temple] [in all cities]
[+2 Faith] from every [Copper Temple] [in all cities]
Comment [There was no need for stained glass, they are too expensive for this realm.]
